home.lead: Tell our AI assistant what’s wrong in Bangla, English or Banglish. It asks one question at a time, then shortlists verified doctors in your city with times you can book.
home.inputPlaceholder: For example: a headache and dizziness since yesterday…
home.emergency: In an emergency, don’t use this service. Call {{number}} or go to the nearest hospital.
home.exampleLabel: Example of a conversation with the assistant
home.previewPatient: Headache and dizziness since yesterday morning
home.previewAssistant: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
home.previewShortlist: Based on what you described, here are doctors who may be able to help.

describe.title: Describe what you feel
describe.body: Write it the way you would tell a relative. The assistant asks one short question at a time. It helps you find a doctor. It does not diagnose or prescribe.

choose.title: See who suits you
choose.body: Get a ranked shortlist of verified doctors, with the reason for each one, the fee and the soonest time.

book.title: Book a real time
book.body: Pick a time from the doctor’s live schedule. If a slot is taken, nobody else can book it.

home.indexLead: Live from our register. Every doctor here passed our credential review.
home.indexUnavailable: We can’t load doctors right now.
home.indexEmpty: No verified doctors are listed yet.

license.title: Credentials are checked
license.body: Doctors submit their BMDC registration and degree certificates, and our team reviews each document.

review.title: Approval comes first
review.body: Only approved doctors appear in search or in the assistant’s shortlist.

recheck.title: Changes are reviewed again
recheck.body: When a doctor edits their profile, it goes back for review before patients can see it.

diagnose.q: Will the assistant tell me what I have?
diagnose.a: No. It never diagnoses, prescribes or says a symptom is harmless. It asks about what you feel so it can point you to the right kind of doctor.

emergency.q: What if it is an emergency?
emergency.a: Don’t use this service. Call {{number}} or go to the nearest hospital. If your message shows a warning sign, the assistant stops and tells you the same.

language.a: Yes. Write in Bangla, English or Banglish, and the assistant replies in the language you use.

privacy.q: What happens to what I write?
privacy.a: You agree before your first message. Names, phone numbers and emails we detect are removed before your words reach the AI provider. Chats are erased after a year without use, and you can erase yours from your account at any time.

fee.a: MediMatch is free for patients. Each doctor sets their own fee, and you see it before you book. You don’t pay inside MediMatch.

join.q: I’m a doctor. how do I join?
join.a: Create a doctor account and send your BMDC registration and degree certificates. Patients see your profile once it is approved. Doctors pay a fee per completed appointment or a monthly subscription, and you choose which.

account.a: You can browse doctors without one. You need an account to use the assistant and to book a time.

cancel.a: Yes. Open My appointments and cancel it. The time becomes free for other patients.

home.startLead: You say what you feel. The assistant does the asking, and you choose the doctor and the time.
home.footer: MediMatch helps you find a doctor. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
home.previewGreeting: Hello. Tell me what you’re feeling, in your own words.
home.proof: Every doctor’s BMDC registration and degree certificates are reviewed before they appear here.
home.problemTitle: Most people start with a symptom, not a specialty
home.problemBody: A doctor search only helps once you know which specialty you need. MediMatch starts with what you feel, asks what it needs to know, and points you to the kind of doctor who can look at it.
home.benefitsTitle: Built for someone who is worried and short of time

words.title: Your own words
words.body: Write in Bangla, English or Banglish, and the reply comes back in the language you used.

questions.title: One question at a time
questions.body: The assistant asks only what it needs to point you to the right kind of doctor.

warning.title: Warning signs first
warning.body: Serious warning signs are checked before any AI is involved, and an alert tells you to call for help.

verified.title: Only verified doctors
verified.body: Nobody appears in search or in a shortlist until our team has approved their documents.

upfront.title: Fee and time up front
upfront.body: You see each doctor’s fee and soonest time before you book, and a booked time can’t be taken by anyone else.

home.promisesTitle: You can change your mind at any step

payment.title: Free for patients
payment.body: Symptom chat, doctor comparison and booking cost nothing. You pay only the doctor’s own fee, which you see before you book.

cancel.title: Cancel from your account
cancel.body: Cancel an upcoming appointment from My appointments, and the time goes back on the doctor’s schedule.

erase.title: Erase your chats
erase.body: Delete your chat history from your account at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What MediMatch keeps about you, where it goes and how long it stays.

stored.title: What we keep
stored.body: Your name, phone number and email, your appointments, and your chats with the assistant once you have agreed to its use. Doctors also send the documents we use to verify them.

providers.title: Who else sees it
providers.body: Groq runs the AI assistant, Pinecone runs doctor search and Supabase hosts our database. Names, phone numbers and emails we detect are removed before your words reach Groq and Pinecone. Detection can miss things, so please leave names out of your messages.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Chats are erased after a year without use. You can erase them sooner from your account. Appointments are kept as records of care.

emergency.title: Emergencies
emergency.body: If you have not agreed to the assistant’s use, an emergency alert still appears, and nothing you wrote is stored.

closing.title: Closing your account
closing.body: Closing your account clears your name and phone number and stops your sign in. Your past appointments stay on the doctor’s records under the name Deleted Patient.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: What MediMatch is, and what it is not.

service.title: What MediMatch does
service.body: MediMatch helps you find a doctor and book a time. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

emergency.title: Emergencies
emergency.body: Don’t use this service in an emergency. Call {{number}} or go to the nearest hospital.

assistant.title: The AI assistant
assistant.body: Replies are written by AI and can be wrong. It never replaces a doctor. Always use your own judgment about when to seek care.

doctors.title: Doctors and fees
doctors.body: Our team reviews each doctor’s documents before they appear. Your care is between you and your doctor. Each doctor sets their own fee, and you don’t pay inside MediMatch.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.body: A booked time is yours until you or the doctor cancels it. When it is cancelled, the time becomes free for other patients.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Keep your details accurate and your password private. You can close a patient account from your account page once you have no upcoming appointments.

billing.title: Fees for doctors
billing.body: MediMatch is free for patients. Doctors pay a fee per completed appointment or a monthly subscription, and choose which from their billing page. Nothing is paid inside the app.

forDoctors.title: Reach patients who are looking for your specialty
forDoctors.lead: Patients describe what they feel, and MediMatch shortlists verified doctors with times they can book. It stays free for patients, so more of them can find you.
forDoctors.plansLead: You pick one plan and can change it later. Nothing is paid inside the app.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Add your practice, experience and consultation fee.

review.title: Send your documents
review.body: Our team reviews your BMDC registration and degree certificates.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.body: Pick how you pay from your billing page, then open your schedule.

billing.title: Billing
billing.lead: MediMatch is free for patients. Doctors pay in one of two ways, and you choose which.

booking_fee.title: Pay per appointment
booking_fee.body: A fee for each appointment you complete. Cancelled appointments cost nothing.

subscription.title: Monthly subscription
subscription.body: One fixed fee each month, with no fee per appointment.
